prerequisites.reason: Feedforward network nodes rely on activation functions to produce outputs.
Gradient descent minimizes an objective such as a loss function.
Backpropagation computes gradients used for gradient-based weight updates.
Backpropagation applies the chain rule through a computational graph.
Backpropagation is commonly defined over neural network computations such as feedforward networks.
Feedforward networks are a foundational neural network architecture.
